Indian Stock Markets Decline for Fourth Consecutive Day

Indian stock markets continued their downward trend for a fourth consecutive day, with the Sensex dropping significantly. One report indicated a fall of 570 points due to relentless foreign fund outflows. Another report stated the Sensex tanked 900 points and the Nifty gave up 22,900, citing key factors dampening market sentiment. The decline follows a massive dip in the previous days, with markets nearing a six-month low.
